questions.question: What is the main contribution of the papers in the collected corpus?
questions.reference: The corpus contains recent arXiv papers covering duality tracing, visual retrieval, safety-aware robotics, claim-centered chemistry search, and prompt auditing.

questions.question: Which paper describes a claim-centered literature synthesis system for chemistry?
questions.reference: The paper AskChem introduces a claim-centered infrastructure for chemistry literature synthesis and evidence-grounded search.

questions.question: How do the papers in the dataset approach retrieval for multimodal tasks?
questions.reference: Several papers explore visual-semantic retrieval and representation learning to bridge images and text for retrieval tasks.

questions.question: Are there any contributions about safety-aware robotics in the corpus?
questions.reference: Yes — the corpus includes recent work on safety-aware planning and risk-aware control in robotics research.

questions.question: Which papers focus on auditing prompts or model behavior?
questions.reference: Some papers propose methods for auditing model prompts and evaluating robustness and alignment in language models.

questions.question: Describe any techniques for claim tracing or citation-aware summarization found in the corpus.
questions.reference: The corpus includes approaches for claim tracing, evidence retrieval, and citation-grounded summarization techniques.
